full_name: Adriaan Lanni | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2017–2018 History Lisa Goldberg Fellow Harvard Law School
bio: Adriaan Lanni is currently the Touroff-Glueck Professor of Law at Harvard Law School. Her research focuses on law and society in classical Athens using methods—particularly legal theory and sociology—that draw as much on her training as a lawyer and law professor as on her background in ancient history.
